d:
And the art of wooing gets a whole new, classy makeover with ‘Azhagiye’! The trusted, magical combo of Mani Ratnam and A.R.Rahman is back again with ‘Kaatru Veliyidai’ starring Karthi and Aditi Rao Hydari.
Watch the official song video here.
Music - AR Rahman
Lyrics - Karky
Additional Punjabi lyrics - Navneeth Virk
Singers - Arjun Chandy, Haricharan, Jonita Gandhi
Backing Vocals - Sid Sriram, Bawa Sahni, Keerthi Sagathia
Guitar - Keba Jeremiah
